spec.query:
from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "outdoor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "outdoorHumid")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["source", "category", "parentId", "_field", "_start", "_stop"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "plantStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "requiredChillers")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "packageStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId =~ /chiller.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0 and r._value <= 3)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with state: if r._value == 1 then "Starting" else if r._value == 2 then "Running" else "Stopping"}))
  |> group(columns: ["state"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","state", "_value"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "plantStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "requiredCoolingTowers")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "packageStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId =~ /chiller.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","deviceId", "state", "_value"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "packageStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId =~ /ct.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","deviceId", "state", "_value"])

import "strings"

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwHeader")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "energyFlowRate")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 78.986})) // convert to RT

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "packageStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId =~ /chiller.*/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 2)
  |> count()

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "packageStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId =~ /ct.*/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 2)
  |> count()

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "outdoor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "radiation")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["source", "category", "parentId", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

import "strings"

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwHeader" or r["deviceId"] == "cwHeader")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "chws" or r["_field"] == "chwr" or r["_field"] == "cwr" or r["_field"] == "cws")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: strings.toUpper(v: r._field)}))

import "strings"

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwHeader")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "energyFlowRate")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 78.986})) // convert to RT
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "outdoor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "outdoorTemp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["source", "category", "parentId", "_field", "_start", "_stop"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "plantStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field != "requiredChillers" and r._field != "requiredCoolingTowers" and r._field != "runningChillers" and r._field != "runningCoolingTowers")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
